## Changeset grade: `patch` → `minor` (7a3f9da63)

One commit on top of `6163cf90d`, touching one file and nothing else:
`.changeset/6840-queryresult-count-value-arms.md`.

```diff
 ---
-'@object-ui/components': patch
-'@object-ui/plugin-view': patch
+'@object-ui/components': minor
+'@object-ui/plugin-view': minor
 ---
```

That is the whole delta — two frontmatter lines. The body is untouched: it
asserts nothing about patch semantics anywhere (the only occurrences of the
word "patch" in the file were the two grade lines themselves), so there was
no prose to correct. No source file, no test, no other changeset.

### Precedent verified before the edit

The predecessor card #6726 shipped the identical change class and graded it
`minor`. Read straight off `origin/main`
(`git show origin/main:.changeset/6726-find-envelope-records-arms.md`):

```
---
'@object-ui/components': minor
'@object-ui/plugin-detail': minor
'@object-ui/plugin-view': minor
---

Seven more `find()` readers now read exactly what `QueryResult` declares — the
`records` arm is removed from each (objectui#6726, following objectui#5945).
```

Both checks hold:

1. **It grades `minor`** — three packages, all `minor`.
2. **Same change class** — a tolerant arm reading an undeclared envelope key,
   deleted from `DataSource.find()` consumers. #6726 removed the `records`
   arm; this PR removes the `count` and `value` arms that #6726 explicitly
   left standing in the very same expressions. Two of #6726's seven modules
   are exactly the two this PR edits: `components/src/hooks/related-count-store.ts`
   and `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`. Not merely a similar class — the
   deferred remainder of the same sweep, as this changeset's own body says
   ("This is the measurement it deferred").

A grade of `patch` for the same removal shape that shipped as `minor` a card
ago would have made the release line read as though the two were different
kinds of change. They are not.

### Verification

A changeset grade change **has no failing state to start from** — there is no
red-first demonstration to give here, and I am not claiming one. What is
measurable is that the changeset gates were green before the edit and are
green after it, and that the bump-policy gate — the one gate with an opinion
about grades — accepts `minor`.

Each gate, run standalone post-edit on the committed tree, with its exit code
captured before any pipe:

```text
$ node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs          # exit 0
Compared the working tree with 3b9c774c5 (merge-base with origin/main): 5 file(s) changed,
4 of them published source of a package the release covers, 0 under a package changesets
ignores, 1 changeset(s) added.
OK  4 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares
1 changeset(s): .changeset/6840-queryresult-count-value-arms.md.

$ pnpm changeset:check                               # exit 0
OK  All workspace packages are in the changeset fixed group.
OK  privatePackages declared: version=true, tag=false.
OK  No changeset declares a `major` bump.

$ node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs          # exit 0
   (this is the "Changeset Bump Policy" job's own command)
OK  No changeset declares a `major` bump.

$ node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs         # exit 0
   (this is the "Changeset Overwrite Report" job's own command)
Compared the working tree with 3b9c774c5 (merge-base with origin/main):
1 changeset(s) added, 0 modified, 0 deleted.
OK  No pre-existing changeset was modified or deleted.
```

(Each `OK` above stands where the gate printed its own green check mark.)

All four ran standalone, post-edit, on the committed tree
(`git rev-parse --short HEAD` = `7a3f9da63`); the first three also ran pre-edit
and were already green. Nothing was NOT MEASURED: no timeout, no shared-lock
wait (these gates are dependency-free `node:fs` scans that finish in about a
second, so no build or test lock was taken), no `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, and no
unbuilt-dependency TS2307 — none of these gates compile anything.

`minor` is also the correct ceiling here on its own terms, independent of the
precedent: AGENTS.md forbids `major` in this repo's fixed group, and
`check-changeset-no-major.mjs` enforces it.

The PR remains a **draft** and auto-merge is **not** armed; landing it stays
with the PM seat.
